works.body:
Nice to meet you! I fell in love at first sight with your unique illustration style, I love the rough look it has. (⁠*⁠˘⁠︶⁠˘⁠*⁠)⁠.⁠｡⁠*⁠♡

I would like to have teacher draw my original character Florence, if that is alright with you. https://toyhou.se/695965.florence
Florence is a very happy and kind child (10), and loves flowers and exploring nature! (⁠ ⁠◜⁠‿⁠◝⁠ ⁠)⁠♡

You can draw them with or without the flower crown. :D
I would like to leave the pose + composition up to teacher if that is alright!

Thank you so much for your time, I hope this request isn't too much (⁠人⁠ ⁠•͈⁠ᴗ⁠•͈⁠)

https://toyhou.se/695965.florence

Hello!
Sorry for the second request.
I really want to ask you to draw a picture of my cat.
What I would like you to draw is a personification of our cats.
We have 5 cats, and I would like you to draw my 3rd and youngest son.

Characteristics of the third boy: White with a light brown-gray blotch on his head. Short hair. Black tail, light blue eyes. He has a very sweet personality to humans and can get around well among other cats. He is a good big brother to his youngest son, playing with and bothering him.

Youngest son is a male black cat, short-haired. He is only 5 months old. His eyes are more golden than copper. He has a mischievous personality. He is very fond of the third boy. He plays with them a lot. He is not shy of people at all.

That's all.
The purpose of use is "I want to love my child.

https://www.instagram.com/p/CxqRx3VStnC/?igshid=NTc4MTIwNjQ2YQ==

こんにちは。
夏鳴さんの絵柄やタッチが好きなので、リクエストを送らせてください！

【要望】
家族の猫２匹を擬人化
表情や構図などは自由にお任せします。

【詳細】
どちらもオスで猫種は推測です。
・ひなた（15）タイ※シャム猫を丸くした感じの種
　おとなしくて甘え下手、どちらかといえばクールな一匹狼です。
・ぐーぐー(12) キジトラ
　ひなたの２～３年後にやってきました。コミュ強で甘え上手。

ぐーぐーが近づくと、ひなたは怒るので、ずっと微妙な距離感で同居しています。
けして仲良しではないですが、稀にくっついたり近くにいたりします。
資料の写真をこちらにアップしております。
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TOZyhOi4z3b7Sc7gcB6nCsj2nmPLLk5g?usp=sharing

よろしくお願いします！

はじめまして、菜と申します。

私の代理キャラクターを描いていただきたいです。
ポーズや構図はお任せします。

資料↓
https://twitter.com/n___nono_/status/1640122382697512960?s=46&t=znrMc5il5LxWovI527LtZw

頂いたイラストはSNSアイコン等で使用したいと思っています。

よろしくお願いいたします。
